description: Servicios territoriales de protección civil is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Executive Council of the Spanish Geographical Information Infrastructure (CODIIGE). Territorial delimitation of the reference territorial areas used in civil protection planning and management in Catalonia. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Territorial Civil protection services" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2026-03-20 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support emergency planning and critical-facility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
